lastCompletedStory.title: Widen frozen-comparand operator alternation and add a correct left anchor

nextStoryContext: INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE in src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts now matches all eight comparison operators (-eq/-ne/-gt/-lt/-ge/-le/==/!=) and requires a left anchor of start-of-string or whitespace via `(?<![\w-])` (excludes both word chars and the hyphen, since a bare \b is insufficient). LIVE_DERIVATION_RE was deliberately left byte-unchanged (out of scope, tracked separately as CAM-386) and still sits at line 171 -- any future edit to INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE's doc comment or code above that line must preserve the same total line count or the byte-unchanged-via-grep-n oracle used to pin LIVE_DERIVATION_RE will fail even though its own text is untouched (see the new patterns.md bullet). RULES still has exactly 4 named rules; module purity (2 imports, no fs/Bun.spawn/etc, unchanged export surface) preserved.
